source: Same reasoning as e^z, for any positive real base != 1
caption: Power(2, ComplexInfinity) is Indeterminate, the same direction-dependence as e^z
A base between 0 and 1 is just as direction-dependent: (1/2)^z -> 0 one way, -> infinity the other
A symbolic or non-positive-real base is left unevaluated -- not decidable without knowing more about the base
wolfram.note: Wolfram answers Indeterminate for any base; ours decides only a positive real constant base and leaves a symbolic one unevaluated
